dct_creator_sm: Amundsen Science Core Data Collection DATA Coordinator : Tahiana Ratsimbazafy.
dct_description_sm: These navigation data were recorded aboard the CCGS Amundsen during the scientific mission 2013 and 2015. They constitute ancillary data for all other data recorded during the scientific expeditions by providing a sound geographical and positioning reference of the vessel during the various sampling operations.
dct_title_s: Amundsen 2013-2015 Navigation data in Canadian, Greenland and US Arctic Seas
